Checking language support on an unregistered OCR backend returns an error, since there is no backend to delegate the check to

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
begin
  result = Xberg.ocr_backend_supports_language('nonexistent-backend-xyz', 'eng')
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
